ideas.pitch: An offline-first crop disease and yield prediction platform tailored for rural farmers with low connectivity, delivering actionable alerts via SMS.
ideas.title: AgriGuard SMS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with UN SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and directly mirrors a proven winning pattern of integrating offline SMS alerts for practical rural utility.

ideas.pitch: A predictive web platform forecasting harmful algal bloom risks days in advance using lightweight machine learning models.
ideas.title: AquaPredict Bay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets environmental sustainability with clear predictive metrics, matching the judging preference for quantified ecological impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool identifying urban heat islands and optimal zones for green infrastructure placement.
ideas.title: UrbanCool Infrastructure Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial data visualisation which consistently scores high among judges evaluating smart city scalability.

ideas.pitch: A crowd-sourced safety mapping and navigation web app highlighting well-lit paths and community-vetted safe spaces for women and vulnerable groups.
ideas.title: SafeRoute Community
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an urgent social challenge directly aligned with UN SDG 5 (Gender Equality) and community safety priorities.

ideas.pitch: A full-stack transparent marketplace connecting local smallholder farmers directly with urban consumers to eliminate middlemen markups.
ideas.title: KisanBazaar Direct
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven hackathon-winning architecture while solving a tangible economic problem for agricultural communities.
